display_name: 浅中层Fishr与受限双向统计扰动：三种子方向对照
description: 固定三种校准策略，各比较POS/BIDIR受限统计方向池，六方案各三种子随机学生20轮，自动clean
authorization: 持续84%三种子均值目标；允许20轮从头探索、合法U半监督、浅中层Fishr和MixStyle、无EMA/星地增强，每卡最多3总进程，逐行自动clean。既有健康实验保持冻结。

checkpoint.initialization: random native student; no student checkpoint loaded
checkpoint.inheritance: other two original source-L-only E20 teachers only; student20 + teacher40 historical model epochs; no auxiliary inheritance
checkpoint.prediction_reuse: same-seed original pureCE E20 P0 score reference; fixed original JOINT counterparts from identity9 only in reference_report
checkpoint.benchmark_context: previously exposed development benchmark, not blind confirmation

metric_names: realized statistical bounds and clipping rates
metrics_plan.reference_missing_policy: N/A until all fixed seeds present; no substitutes or selected reruns

test_completion_plan.row_trigger: fixed final scratch20 + source freeze -> predict -> separate scorer

independent_review.scope: 18rows;matched directions and bounded logstats;identity gradients/RNG/hooks;source/teacher provenance;auto truth-last;capacity3

notes: Source rationale: original MixStyle convex interpolation; complete six-row source counterfactual in scratch27. No target score selected policy, seed or perturbation.
6 arms x3 seeds: DELAY/CAP/DELAYCAP xPOS/BIDIR. Primary DELAYCAP_BIDIR, paired DELAYCAP_POS. All three direction contrasts retained.

Bounded detached mean/log-scale transform: mean <=ramp*sigma, scale in [2^-ramp,2^ramp]. POS ++++; BIDIR +-+-. Same four private candidate seeds and legal L donors. Identity plus four whole-batch candidates, maxCE,5eval+1train.
Reference identity9 includes log-scale/clipping differences as well as direction. No single-factor claim for cross-run references. No original-IQ physical invariance claim.
L6300,U56700 hidden TX,V27000 health only. Random student, fixed original E20 peer probabilities from other seeds and verified source-only ancestry. No target/V fit,EMA,satellite.
20epochs4440updates;warm444/ramp888;999 independent AB60 Fishr;12pair L calibration at0/444;optional complete disjoint joint gradient cap0.2. No auxiliary learned heads.
Historical teacher40 plus student20 model epochs; fixed final20 all18 clean168000. All negative results retained; no target-driven reruns.
